$comment: LSP wiring for this checkout. clangd.path and python.defaultInterpreterPath are deliberately NOT set here: workspace scope would override the user's per-platform values. Set them in VS Code User settings exactly as docs/building.md (Editor setup) spells out for your platform. Memory tuning: this host class has ~13 GB RAM, so clangd indexes in the background with 4 workers and trims its heap; the codec is ~12 translation units, so the index stays small.
